Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Mayank Awasthi, learned Brief Holder for the State.

The applicant has preferred the instant application with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide application filed him dated 30.0.2024 in Criminal Case No. 631 of 2019, State v. Manpreet and others, arising out of Case Crime No. 17 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 377 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Rampur, seeking permission for attending marriage of near relative in Canada for 30 days i.e. from 17th October to 17th November, 2024.
